source.name: The Movie Database (TMDB) Comprehensive Dataset

audit.schemaAssessment: Relational joins are intact and IDs are unique after skipping one malformed movies.csv row. Zero budget/revenue values are treated as missing.

methodology.outcomeMetric: TMDB vote_average (community rating), scaled from 0-10 to 0-100
methodology.notAProxyFor: Rotten Tomatoes Tomatometer or Kalshi threshold probability
eligibility: At least 100 TMDB votes and a positive vote_average
Target movie ID 1423191 is excluded from all outcomes
methodology.cohortRule: English-language films tagged both Horror and Science Fiction, released since 2000, with at least 100 TMDB votes by the snapshot date.
methodology.shrinkage: Talent and franchise averages use empirical-Bayes shrinkage equivalent to 5 comparable-cohort films.
leakageControls: No target-film vote, popularity, review, budget, or revenue value is used.
No release after the dataset snapshot is used as an outcome.
Popularity, reviews, trailer, search, social, critic, and Kalshi fields are not model inputs.
Historical revenue is descriptive only because the target budget is unavailable.

financialContext.caveat: Revenue exceeding production budget is not the same as profitability; marketing and distribution costs are unavailable.

factors.label: Director prior
factors.detail: Prior released films directed by the target director; small samples shrink toward the comparable cohort.

factors.label: Producer prior
factors.detail: Unique prior released films credited to the target producers; duplicate producer credits count once.

factors.label: Franchise prior
factors.detail: Prior eligible Resident Evil titles in the dataset.
titles: Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City

factors.label: Genre cohort
factors.detail: English-language Horror + Science Fiction releases since 2000 with at least 100 TMDB votes.

factors.label: September context
titles: The Girl with All the Gifts

factors.label: Lead cast prior
factors.detail: Unique prior eligible films for the target film's top four billed cast members.

factors.label: Director prior
factors.detail: Prior eligible films directed by the target director.

factors.label: Producer prior
factors.detail: Unique prior eligible films credited to the target producers.

factors.label: Historical ratings
factors.detail: Every comparable film passes the rating and vote-count eligibility rule.

factors.label: Named talent priors
factors.detail: 11 of 11 named cast, director, and producer identities have at least one eligible prior film.

factors.label: Budget completeness
factors.detail: Positive production budgets in the comparable cohort; zero is treated as missing.

factors.label: Revenue completeness
factors.detail: Positive theatrical revenue in the comparable cohort; zero is treated as missing.

factors.label: Target feature fields
factors.detail: Release, language, genres, runtime, budget, director, lead cast, and producer groups present for the target. Target runtime and budget are unavailable in this snapshot.

thresholdCalibration.reason: This Kaggle source has TMDB community ratings, not Rotten Tomatoes critic outcomes. It cannot honestly estimate P(Tomatometer > threshold).
